message: Command `grep -n "codegen_realloc\|icapa\|iseq" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/mrbgems/mruby-compiler/core/codegen.c | head -40` executed with exit code 0.

message.content:
I see. The dispatch is called with `pos+i*3+1` where `pos` is a label position. The issue is that `dispatch` reads `PEEK_S(s->iseq+pos0)` which reads 2 bytes. If `pos0` is at the last byte of the iseq buffer, this reads 1 byte OOB.

Let me look at the OSS-Fuzz issue. The testcase ID is 5377616977723392. Let me check if there's any reference to the fix. Let me look at how the iseq buffer is allocated and understand when `pos0` could point to the end:
